_doc: Recorded ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 11 (QASv2 quasi-analytical targets) engine-run results for fluxion's own air-side model (Issue #4274). GENERATED by the §11 engine-run harness (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/section11_engine_run.rs) — re-record with FLUXION_SECTION11_WRITE_RESULTS; never hand-edit.
_method: Each case × system is dispatched through fluxion's own air-side components (CoolingCoil, HeatingCoilComponent, FanComponent) and fluxion-core psychrometrics in the QAS configuration; the system-level glue (outdoor/return mixing, flow splits, zone load balances) is harness code and is flagged on every affected row. The QAS targets are point values, not bands: no band is fitted to the engine output.

_status_legend.known_fail: the engine value is outside the comparison tolerance — recorded with the real engine value, target and gap
_status_legend.not_runnable: the quantity cannot be produced by fluxion's air-side API; the row quotes the API gap
_status_legend.pass: the engine value is inside the declared comparison tolerance

_targets: data/reference/ashrae140/section11_qas_targets.json (QASv2.xlsm, merged quasi-analytical solution, ASHRAE RP-865; economizer off, zero return-duct heat gain)
